_doc: Performance budgets (Step 41). sim: tools/bench/sim_bench.gd --size N --hours H --offline 8 --check -- the result hash of StressIsland after H simulated hours must stay exactly this (the code may only get faster, never play differently), wall ms per simulated hour and the 8-hour offline catch-up's wall seconds stay under budget (desktop, headless; a busy machine needs the headroom). The hash changes only when the rules do: Step 42 rebalanced the data (780062055 -> 174450136); Step 50 rebuilt the pacing (174450136 -> 3519915397) -- its five-second farm cycle lives 670,000 events in the bench hour where Step 49 lived 45,000, each cheaper (39 us against 136 us), so the hour's budget follows the events, not the code. Before Step 41 the 30x30 island took 42,527 ms per simulated hour and its capped catch-up 127.9 s. render: tools/bench/render_bench.gd --check, run with godot --fixed-fps 60 -- per second on the large demo island, counts not times (the same on any machine): building rings redrawn, Momo bodies redrawn, buildings and Momo animating, nodes running per-frame code. Before Step 41: 11,520 rings and 3,840 Momo bodies a second, all 347 nodes always processing.
